race.title: Why Bet Elsewhere, David Lucas Bookmakers Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
race.verdict: The betting will undoubtedly prove informative but MOMENTS IN TIME showed plenty when twice finishing fourth in bumpers last season and, following a subsequent breathing operation, looks very interesting now hurdling over a trip that should suit. Course bumper winner Bande Organisee is another of firm interest, with Exeter scorer All About Trev and Kimai 2 others entering the reckoning. MOMENTS IN TIME (IRE) BANDE ORGANISEE (FR) ALL ABOUT TREV (IRE)
